The webview HTML loads external resources (Tailwind CSS CDN and Google Fonts) from `cdn.tailwindcss.com` and `fonts.googleapis.com`. While these are well-known and generally safe, loading external scripts in a webview is a potential vector for supply-chain attacks if the CDN is compromised, and it violates the principle of least privilege for local extensions.
